title: RecoveryReceipt
description: EIP-712 typed receipt emitted by the registered compensator after recovery is attempted. Realizes the recovery evidence object r in the settleability model (main.tex:128).

effectReceiptHash.description: EIP-712 digest of the EffectReceipt this recovery responds to.

restoreArtifactHash.description: Hash of the restore artifact (snapshot blob, reflog dump, prior-config JSON) stored in the evidence store.

outcome.description: Result of the compensator invocation. 'inconclusive' is emitted automatically when no schema-valid receipt arrived before Δ_ρ (main.tex:263).

residualMeasurements.description: Schema-defined residual measurements, keyed by the κ.coveredLossClass codes. Each entry is the agreed measurement, its evidence source, and the rule by which it maps into P(o,r). Adapter-specific shape; the ClaimRegistry does not parse beyond ensuring required keys exist.

value.description: Decimal-string value to preserve precision (rows, seconds, USD-cents, bytes).

evidenceSource.description: Where this measurement was computed. provider-receipt and snapshot-diff are L1; cost-explorer is L1 for AWS; reflog is L2; compensator-attested is L2.

artifactHash.description: Optional pointer into the evidence store.
